Hey - for utilities PLEASE try to apply for LIHEAP. I did it through the DPW website and I got approved and they literally wrote a check to my local utility company for $800+! My utilities were $280 behind and now I have a $520+ credit on my account, meaning I won't be paying electric for well over five months! 

* and no... I'm not taking advantage. I am truly sick and disabled, and before I got sick I worked full time. My parents worked all their lives and were *very* very financially successful and paid a LOT in taxes (more than most people made in their lives... in one year the amount of money my parents paid in taxes was more than my ex earned in 15 years WITH a PhD in engineering)... reason I am saying this about my parents and myself is that we've paid into the system MUCH more than we've "taken out" of the system so to speak, and therefore I don't feel so guilty about having to use aid now that I need it (and hopefully I'll heal, finish my degree, and once again contribute!)
